title: Fractions & decimals on a number line

questions.q: A number line from 0 to 1 is cut into 10 equal parts. A point is on the 3rd mark after 0. What fraction is it? [img:tenths-dot3]
questions.why: Ten equal parts means tenths. The 3rd mark is 3 tenths = 3/10.

questions.q: Same number line (0 to 1, cut into 10 equal parts). The point is on the 3rd mark. What decimal is it? [img:tenths-dot3]
A number line from 0 to 1 is cut into 4 equal parts. A point is on the 3rd mark after 0. What fraction is it? [img:fourths-dot3]
questions.why: Four equal parts means fourths. The 3rd mark is 3/4.

questions.q: A number line from 0 to 1 is cut into 10 equal parts. A point is halfway between the 4th and 5th marks. Which hundredths decimal is it? (Hint: halfway between 0.4 and 0.5.) [img:tenths-between]
Which number is the same as 0.5 on a number line? [img:half-dot]
questions.why: 0.5 is 5 tenths, which is exactly halfway from 0 to 1. That is 1/2.

questions.q: A number line goes from 0 to 1 with marks at every 0.1. Which point is farther to the right? [img:tenths-labeled]
questions.why: Compare 7 tenths and 6 tenths. 0.7 is farther right, so it is greater.

questions.q: Which list is in order from least to greatest (left to right on a number line)? [img:tenths-labeled]
questions.why: Write them with hundredths: 0.20, 0.25, 0.30. Those go up in order.

questions.q: Which is greater: 0.6 or 0.58? Think about where each sits on a number line. [img:hundredths-zoom]
questions.why: 0.6 = 0.60, which is 60 hundredths. 58 hundredths is less, so 0.6 is farther right.

questions.q: Each whole on a number line is cut into 4 equal parts. A point is on the 6th mark after 0. Which mixed number is it? [img:fourths-0-2]
Which fraction is closest to 0 on a number line? [img:eighths]
questions.why: The bigger the bottom number, the smaller each piece. 1/8 is the smallest of these, so it is closest to 0.

questions.q: A number line from 0 to 1 is cut into 100 equal parts. A point is on the 25th mark. Which decimal and fraction is it? [img:hundredths-dot25]
